name: Nitin Jain
current_role: Former co-founder & Chief Business Officer, OfBusiness (left Dec 2025; new venture announced as upcoming)
profile: IIT Delhi graduate who spent seven years at Royal Bank of Scotland in London (VP, structured solutions trading) before co-founding OfBusiness in 2016, a B2B raw-material procurement and credit platform for Indian SMEs with lending arm Oxyzo. He left in Dec 2025, saying 'Something big is upcoming', hinting at manufacturing.
interesting_fact: In his Dec 2025 LinkedIn farewell from IPO-bound OfBusiness he said 'Something big is upcoming' and, asked about manufacturing, replied his next move would be 'around these lines'.
deep_cut_fact: He was a silver medalist at IIT Delhi and worked in investment banking in London, where he faced a culture shock and even unexpected layoffs, before returning to India as a founding team member of OfBusiness.

public_contacts.value: Interview: The Desi VC podcast E112 (Nitin Jain, Co-founder & CBO, OfBusiness)

notes: Left OfBusiness Dec 2025; new venture not yet named in sources found. He announced the move on LinkedIn, so LinkedIn is the likely best route. Hurun lists the $5B valuation, which belongs to OfBusiness, not his own stake. The podcast entry is a past interview he gave, not a channel he runs.

name: Logan Head
current_role: Co-founder and CTO, Whatnot (livestream shopping marketplace)
profile: Engineer who co-founded Whatnot with CEO Grant LaFontaine in Los Angeles in December 2019, inspired by their shared collectibles habits; the app went through Y Combinator and grew into the leading US live-shopping marketplace, reportedly valued around $20B by 2026. Head leads engineering and product.
interesting_fact: Whatnot's first livestream test split the founders' own Funko Pop collection between static listings and live auctions; the livestreamed half sold out in about 2.5 hours, earning roughly $5,000 in one evening.
deep_cut_fact: He built Whatnot's first livestream product by shutting himself in his room for roughly four to five weeks; LaFontaine said he was 'coding 16 hours a day, six days a week,' and Head was nervous the livestream format wouldn't work.
notes: Low public profile; LaFontaine is the public face. No official Whatnot press email found (only in-app support). Pre-Whatnot roles (GOAT, Flight Club) appear only in third-party profiles and were not confirmed from primary sources.

name: Austin Woodward
current_role: Co-founder and Executive Chairman, TaxBit (CEO until June 2023)
profile: Accountant-turned-founder who co-founded Utah-based TaxBit in 2017 with his brother Justin, a tax attorney, to automate tax reporting for crypto/digital assets. As CEO he raised about $230M (Paradigm, Tiger Global, IVP, Insight) and built enterprise and government businesses; in June 2023 he handed the CEO role to COO Lindsey Argalas and became chairman.
interesting_fact: TaxBit's $100M Series A in 2021, led by Paradigm and Tiger Global, was reported as the largest Series A in Utah history.
deep_cut_fact: He prefers the term 'digital assets' over 'cryptocurrency' because it covers more, and has said running a business is 'brutally transparent and honest'.
notes: The press email comes from a June 2023 TaxBit release. Secondary sources (podcast notes and directories) say he was a CPA and an early Qualtrics hire, but no primary source confirmed it, so it is not used above. His involvement has been chairman-level since 2023.
